title.instructions: A few words naming the feature or fix, no leading verb.

branchName.instructions: Use <type>/<short-desc> in kebab-case, where type is feat, fix, refactor, docs, or chore. Base new task branches on dev, never on main.

commitMessage.instructions: Use Conventional Commits with a scope (for example feat(sidebar): ...). Never mention other Paseo plugins.

pullRequest.instructions: Target dev, never main. Lead with a one-paragraph summary, then a Test plan section listing typecheck and in-app checks. Never mention other Paseo plugins.
